text: 东吴证券发布公告称，公司拟通过发行股份及支付现金的方式购买常州投资集团有限公司等60名交易对方持有的东海证券股份有限公司83.68%的股份，中国证监会于近期就本次交易涉及的包括东吴证券变更主要股东、东海证券股份有限公司变更控股股东及实际控制人、东海期货有限责任公司变更实际控制人等行政许可申请依法予以受理，并出具《中国证监会行政许可申请受理单》。
text_en: Soochow Securities announced plans to acquire 83.68% of Donghai Securities from 60 sellers, including Changzhou Investment Group, via share issuance and cash. The CSRC has recently accepted the related administrative license applications, including changes to Soochow Securities' major shareholders and Donghai Securities' controlling shareholder and actual controller, as well as Donghai Futures' actual controller, and issued acceptance notices.
